summary.name: chasquid
summary.one_liner: chasquid is an SMTP (email) server focused on simplicity, security, and ease of operation, written in Go and licensed Apache-2.0.
use_cases: send and receive email for your own domains
validate DKIM signatures on incoming mail
operate a simple secure SMTP server
summary.what_it_does: chasquid is an SMTP server for email, described as focused on simplicity, security, and ease of operation. The page is a git repository view listing recent commits from 2026, including changes to DKIM domain validation, SMTP address and HELO/EHLO sanitization, SNI hostname handling, and trace message truncation. The repository contains Go source files (chasquid.go, monitoring.go, dnsoverride.go), a docs/ directory, and Docker and test directories. Branches include main, next, disable-domaininfo-incoming, and smarthost, and tags run from v0.01 to v1.19.0.
notable: SMTP server focused on simplicity, security, and ease of operation
Includes DKIM validation and SMTP input sanitization changes
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under mail transfer agents
